# TensorFlow Lite Micro, the part the CPU-only baselines link

From https://github.com/tensorflow/tflite-micro at commit `c0ecf6ffaa571068fa905339776161124d4b77dd`
(2026-11-12 23:18:28 UTC; the tflite-micro Python package 0.dev20261112231828 that made
`mlperf/reference_kws01.json` is built from it). Made by `mlperf/tflm_vendor.py`: TFLM's own
generator (`tensorflow/lite/micro/tools/project_generation/create_tflm_tree.py --rename_cc_to_cpp <dir>`), then the 34 sources the KWS firmware links
(in `sw/applications/tflm_mlperf/tflm/`), the 34 sources the ResNet8 firmware links (in
`sw/applications/tflm_resnet/tflm/`: the same without the depthwise kernel, with the ADD kernel) and the
95 headers they include (here). The headers are
kept outside `sw/`: X-HEEP's build puts every directory under an app that holds a header on the include
path, and FlatBuffers' `flatbuffers/string.h` would then hide `<string.h>`. Unchanged; Apache License 2.0
(`LICENSE`, `third_party/flatbuffers/LICENSE`, in all three places).
